Subject: Compatibility checklist + A/B exception flow for NovaHealth promptset rollout

Quick sync: NovaHealth is green to start the A/B next week but legal asked for a more prescriptive compatibility checklist and an explicit exception/rollback flow we can point to in the SOW. I sketched an initial list and the minimal rollback criteria — see attached.

High level asks from Product/Customer ops:
- Product wants explicit acceptance criteria for both quality (NPS/QA pass rate) and safety regressions.
- CS wants deterministic rollback triggers (thresholds + timeline) and who owns the rollback decision.
- SRE needs compatibility items for inference latency and KV cache behavior across the dedicated pool.

Please review the attached nvh-compatibility-checklist.xlsx and the AB plan (ab-plan-v1.md). Comments welcome — I need a consolidated checklist and the exception flow by EOD Monday so we can share with NovaHealth and legal.

Proposed owners: Marissa (product acceptance), Karthik (runtime compatibility + rollback runbook), Hannah (eval metrics and gating). Aditya — can you validate the rollout window constraints with Dedicated?

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Quality & Eval Coordination
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nvh-compatibility-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), ab-plan-v1.md (text), INF-7621 (Jira)

Thanks Rishi — read through the checklist. A few product asks to add (quick bullets):
- Acceptance signal: two-week rolling window where primary promptset shows <= 1.5% drop vs control on the key clinical-extraction metric (F1), and no >0.1% increase in hallucination signals measured by the regression eval harness.
- Canary cadence: 5% traffic for 48 hours, then 20% for 72 hours if no flags.
- Decision authority: Product + CS to sign off on canary -> ramp; Exec QoS (Rishi) to trigger rollback if quality threshold breached.

Also added a small note that we should codify the manual escalation channel (Slack #prod-evals and a paging rotation) so CS can page if they see customer-impacting issues.

I attached a short AB plan comment file (embedded in ab-plan-v1.md). Marissa

--

Adding runtime/compatibility constraints and a suggested rollback runbook. Key technical notes:
- KV cache: the new promptset increases typical prefix size ~12% — ensure cache warming in Dedicated pool to avoid spike in cold-start latency. SRE checklist item: pre-warm cache for the first 24h of the canary.
- Latency SLO: p95 must not exceed baseline p95 by more than 30ms during canary; if exceeded for 3 consecutive 5-min windows, auto-scale and notify owners.
- Rollback runbook (suggested):
    1) If quality threshold breached (Marissa/Hannah confirmed), pause ramp and switch traffic to control within 15 minutes.
    2) If latency threshold breached and auto-scaling doesn't stabilize latency within 30 minutes, trigger rollback and open RCA with SRE + Runtime.
    3) If both quality and latency issues are present, immediate rollback and executive notification.

I've attached a short technical appendix in the checklist and added a line in Jira INF-7621 to track the prewarm job. I can own the prewarm script and the SRE coordination.

-Karthik

Thanks all — I ran the regression harness against the candidate promptset and added concrete gating thresholds to the checklist:
- RegEval: no more than 0.08% increase in hallucination labels across the sampled production-like prompts (n=12k).
- QA pass rate: >= 96.5% on the core extraction suite over a 10k sample in canary traffic.
- False-positives: maintain below 0.5% absolute delta vs control.

I've pushed a read-only copy of the eval report to Drive (link below) and attached a short summary. If we hit a marginal failure (e.g., QA = 95.9%), propose we enter an "investigate & hold" state for 24h while we triage with the retrieval/product teams before a full rollback.

Drive report: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-nvh-compatibility

Hannah

Appreciate the thoroughness. A few quick confirmations from our side:
- The proposed canary windows look fine; can we avoid scheduling the 20% ramp on Friday evenings due to reduced support staffing? Prefer Tue–Thu windows.
- If you implement the "investigate & hold" state, can you guarantee a documented RCA or summary for us within 48h of any pause/rollback? That will be a clause in our internal change review.
- Please include an explicit contact list (phone + escalation order) for paging — we want to avoid noisy Slack with ambiguous ownership.

Once you update the checklist with the gating thresholds and the escalation contacts I’ll sign the SOW change and confirm the go-ahead for the first canary starting Tue Apr 16.

Thanks,
